tool: built-in image_gen for lighting and independent background; deterministic layered alpha composite for icon
background_prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: standalone background layer for a rounded-square application icon. This request is BACKGROUND ONLY. The mascot will be added separately with deterministic layer compositing, so DO NOT draw any character, mascot, logo, book, hat, feather, icon, letters, symbols, stars, particles, decorative objects or frame.
Create a perfectly SQUARE 1024x1024 smooth opaque navy-to-cobalt background, full bleed to all 4 edges, with NO rounded corners yet (rounding is applied later as a precise mask).
Elegant very restrained gradient: deep midnight ink blue #13213E near corners/outer edges; a broad soft diffuse muted cobalt #253E78 gently illuminating the central area behind a future mascot. Quiet and low-contrast, no circular border, no visible spotlight disk, no horizon, no vignette so strong that the edge becomes black. Keep the upper and lower halves balanced, not a bright top and dark bottom. Crisp mathematically smooth looking color transitions, no stripes or banding, no texture or grain, no gloss, no emboss, no image of a phone, no transparency, no text, no 3D. One clean empty background image only.
compositing: Use saved corrected logo as fixed foreground. Apply precise rounded mask to separate background. Uniformly scale/place logo, then alpha composite; no generative re-render of mascot. Remove only detached alpha speckles outside the connected mascot.
